name: a planted empty restriction refuses everyone honestly
notes: The wf_rules "Guarded" definition is the advisory tier's deliberately-warned example: its any-state → "Done" edge carries no rules, so adviseWorkflowDef reports rule-bypassable on this def (coordination doc §8, requirement 4). Unlike its eighteen siblings this copy would NOT publish — the planted restrict-to names nobody, which is an empty-restrict-to error — and the advisory speaks about it anyway, because a guard that names nobody and a path around the guard are two separate things to fix (case 4.48). The wildcard is left uncovered on purpose — an empty wildcard beside the guarded "Doing" → "Done" edge is what makes these fixtures depend on exact-over-wildcard precedence, and a covering guard would retire that witness while leaving every one of them green.
